skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply principles of national account accounting to economic activities in an open economy and record international transactions in the balance of payments.
Use monetary approach to determine long-term exchange rates and asset approach for short-term rates.
Analyze and explain the role of exchange rates in international economic transactions.
Evaluate the impact of international economic events on macroeconomics and choose appropriate exchange rate policies.
Conduct independent research on international macroeconomic issues such as economic and financial crises.
Work independently and in teams, organize discussions, build scenarios, present and critique real-world situations.
Critically analyze and evaluate the effects of policies aimed at addressing shocks and stabilizing the macroeconomy.
